decision_grid.row_time: end of the hourly UTC bar
decision_grid.rows: hours in which at least one 5-minute bar exists (market open)

Y_s.definition: ln(C_asof(t+h) / C(t)), C_asof = close of last bar ending <= t+h (elapsed hours, not rows)

Y_l.definition: same as Y_s at long horizons; staleness (weekend) recorded per row

rules.entry: close of the bar ending at t
rules.barrier_width: w = width_sigma_mult * sigma_t * sqrt(timeout_h); TP = entry*exp(+w), SL = entry*exp(-w)
rules.path: 5-minute bars whose start >= t and whose end <= t + timeout_h (elapsed time, weekends included)
rules.label: +1 TP touched first, -1 SL touched first, 0 neither by timeout
rules.intrabar_ambiguity: both touched inside one 5-minute bar -> AMBIGUOUS, label NaN, flag kept (version v1: no tick data)
rules.censoring: t + timeout_h >= READ_END -> CENSORED, label NaN
rules.costs: none inside the label; costs belong to J_policy
rules.tp_sl_source: fixed rule above; never an oracle forecast

sigma.available_at: t (includes the return of the bar ending at t)

J_policy.definition: episode objective of the RL/heuristic environment: net PnL after spread, commission and swap, subject to declared risk limits; specified by the environment contract (gym-fx / heuristic-strategy)
J_policy.blocked_on: no historical EURUSD spread series in the lake (OHLC only); environment cost contract not bound here

purge.label_purge_rule: fold-train row t kept iff t + label_purge_h < validation block start
purge.derived_from: max target support (Y_s, Y_l, Y_b timeouts) in elapsed hours
purge.feature_embargo_rule: forward-chaining folds: no training row lies after a validation row, so window support needs no embargo

asof_join.rule: value usable at t iff availability_time <= t; ties at equality admitted; age = t - availability_time in elapsed hours; no backfill, no forward fill past the declared max age

selection_scope: selection and threshold fitting only on inner TRAIN folds; external validation does not select; test is never read
